form_mention only: de in this pilot

candidate, accepted or rejected; validation alone does not promote a candidate; acceptance is not independent benchmark gold
Nonempty reviewer, timezone-qualified reviewed_at, mode, method_version and evidence; modes: same_agent_source_review, prediction_exposed_review, independent_source_review
Explicit list of older same-witness annotation IDs; one accepted replacement per retired claim; cycles, missing claims and cross-witness replacements rejected; old claims retained
Generated only: superseded if explicitly replaced, otherwise the reviewed status; never supplied as an input claim
